newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-TELEPAR STILL A HOLD.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-TELEPAR STILL A HOLD.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc and its local associate Banco Patrimonio said they maintained their hold recommendation on Brazilian telecoms operator Telepar.
-- In a report, Patrimonio analyst Ricardo Gurman said Telepar's first first-half financial results were in line with projections.

-- Telepar reported a net income of 41 million reais in the second quarter and 74 million reais in the first half, up from 38 million reais in second quarter 1996 and a 10-percent hike over first-half results last year.

-- Gurman said the banks were maintaining their earnings estimates of 185 million reais for 1997 and 232 million for 1998 as well as their hold recommendation because "Telepar's current multiples are fair. The stock is trading at 5.2 times 1997 estimated EBITDA and $2,400 the 1997 estimated total fixed and cellular lines in service," he said.
-- The numbers compare favorably to 5.5 times and $2,500 respectively for the average of Brazil's telecoms sector.
-- Telepar common was up 1.37 percent at 740 reais while its preferred was 5.26 percent higher at 900 reais at 1241 local/1541 GMT in Sao Paulo.
